scenarios.prompt: A product sold 1000 units at $100. Price raised to $115 and sales fell to 820 units. Compute the arc (midpoint) elasticity of demand. Use the symmetric midpoint formula: Ed = ((Q2-Q1)/((Q1+Q2)/2)) / ((P2-P1)/((P1+P2)/2)). Report elasticity (signed, negative for normal goods) and abs_elasticity.
At the current price P = $50, quantity sold Q = 2000 units, and the demand curve slope dQ/dP = -30. Compute the point elasticity of demand: Ed = (dQ/dP) × (P/Q). Report elasticity and abs_elasticity.
